name: personal-newsletter
description: Generate daily personal newsletters from curated X account pools for AI and US stocks, using free cookie-based bird access by default.

interface.shortDescription: Daily AI and US stocks newsletters from curated X accounts.
interface.longDescription: Collects posts from curated AI and US stocks account pools, groups account-pool hotspots, drafts multilingual newsletters, and delivers them through email or configured webhooks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Generate today's AI or US stocks newsletter from my configured X account pool.
